privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy describes how ActoCore (“we”, “us”) collects and uses information when you use our website and products.

collect.title: Information we collect
collect.body: We collect account information you provide (such as name and email), usage data related to API and chat requests, and technical logs needed to operate the service.

use.title: How we use information
use.body: We use data to provide and improve ActoCore, secure the platform, process billing, and communicate about your account.

share.title: Sharing
share.body: We do not sell personal data. We share information with subprocessors (such as hosting and payment providers) only as needed to deliver the service.

contact.title: Contact
contact.body: For privacy questions, contact us at privacy@actocore.pro.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using ActoCore, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.

service.title: The service
service.body: ActoCore provides an AI integration platform including Studio, APIs, and an embeddable SDK. Features and limits depend on your subscription plan.

accounts.title: Accounts

acceptable.title: Acceptable use
acceptable.body: You may not misuse the service, attempt unauthorized access, or use ActoCore in violation of applicable law or third-party rights.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
